FIELD NOTES · GENERAL INFORMATION

Make the most of your consultation

Give your questions a little space before you get in touch.

Write down what you want to understand. Ask what is known, what is uncertain and what the next step involves. Keep a list of current medicines and supplements when preparing your questions. You can begin an enquiry without sending sensitive medical records.

Bring your questions into the conversation

You do not have to make a decision immediately. Ask Dr Stevens for clear product information, including ingredients, directions and what to consider for your circumstances.

For personal guidance, speak with Dr Stevens directly and he will talk through the product and the right next step.
